name: refactor_aspnet_duplicate_endpoints
description: Refactors two minimal API endpoints that duplicate the same name-validation/normalization logic into a shared helper
prompts: This is an ASP.NET Core minimal API project (app.csproj targets net8.0). Program.cs has two endpoints, GET /greet/formal and GET /greet/casual, each reading a 'name' query parameter and normalizing it (capitalizing the first letter, lowercasing the rest), but the validation-and-normalization code is duplicated verbatim between the two handlers. Refactor Program.cs to remove the duplication (for example, extract a shared local function or helper method for validating and normalizing the name) while preserving the exact same external behavior: GET /greet/formal?name=alice must return HTTP 200 with JSON {"greeting": "Good day, Alice."}, GET /greet/casual?name=alice must return HTTP 200 with JSON {"greeting": "Hey Alice!"}, and both endpoints must return HTTP 400 with a JSON error body when the 'name' query parameter is missing or blank. Do not change the port (8054).

test_setup_files.test_greet.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, glob, urllib.request, urllib.error

subprocess.run(['dotnet', 'build', '-c', 'Release', '-o', 'out'], check=True)
dlls = glob.glob('out/*.dll')
dll = [d for d in dlls if 'app' in d.lower()][0]
srv = subprocess.Popen(['dotnet', dll])

def get(path):
    url = f'http://127.0.0.1:8054{path}'
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=5) as resp:
            return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        try:
            payload = json.loads(e.read())
        except Exception:
            payload = {}
        return e.code, payload

try:
    ok = False
    for _ in range(40):
        try:
            status, payload = get('/greet/formal?name=alice')
            ok = True
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert ok, 'server never became reachable on :8054'
    assert status == 200, f'expected 200, got {status}'
    assert payload.get('greeting') == 'Good day, Alice.', f'unexpected greeting: {payload!r}'

    status2, payload2 = get('/greet/casual?name=alice')
    assert status2 == 200, f'expected 200, got {status2}'
    assert payload2.get('greeting') == 'Hey Alice!', f'unexpected greeting: {payload2!r}'

    # Mixed-case input specifically catches a broken refactor that forgets to
    # lowercase the remainder of the name (an all-lowercase input like
    # "alice" would not expose that regression).
    status2b, payload2b = get('/greet/formal?name=aliCE')
    assert status2b == 200, f'expected 200, got {status2b}'
    assert payload2b.get('greeting') == 'Good day, Alice.', f'unexpected greeting for mixed-case input: {payload2b!r}'

    status3, payload3 = get('/greet/formal')
    assert status3 == 400, f'expected 400 for missing name, got {status3}'

    status4, payload4 = get('/greet/casual?name=%20%20')
    assert status4 == 400, f'expected 400 for blank name, got {status4}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()

source = open('Program.cs', encoding='utf-8').read()
occurrences = source.count('ToUpperInvariant')
assert occurrences <= 1, f'duplicated validation/normalization logic (\"ToUpperInvariant\") still appears {occurrences} times across both endpoints - it must be extracted into one shared helper, not copy-pasted'
print('PASS')
